strings.en: I'll be the one to finish you...!
All that awaits you is... death.
Curse your luck for meeting me!
Your luck's run out... Go down!
Are you ready? Then here I come!
If you don't want to die, move aside!
You have nowhere left to run!
Can you enjoy your own death, too?
Out of my way. I have no time to play with you!
Your moves are too straightforward, Jua-Mu!
You threw away your pride, and now you hold a grudge?
Jua-Mu, I have my own reasons not to back down...!
I won't let you get a bead on me, Fu-Ruu!
Your schemes end in failure here!
Gu-Landon,/　your brethren in the afterlife await you!
Sleep, Gu-Landon... in ice that never melts!
So the Captain's hunch was right...!
The Balshem Series... Their true aim is...
Their manner may be gentle, but in reality...
You're trying to make me drop my guard...
You don't seem to see the situation, Vort!
Reggiane, I have no time to deal with you.
Don't think you can keep laughing forever.
If it's unmanned, there's no need for restraint.
So it doesn't matter what they control...!
That crystal body... I'll smash it.
I'll crush you, armor and all!
That's supposed to be a knight...?
You're the one who'll perish here, XN-L!
You think you can face me in a unit like that?
These guys don't know when to quit...!
I'll go for the commander's unit.
I'll take down the commander unit...!
I'll land a direct hit on its engine!
Its design differs from previous Zovorg units...
Is it really a new Zovorg model?
Don't think a Thick Cylinder can stop me.
Thorn... So you've entered my range.
The sharper the thorn, the easier it breaks!
If I can take out the leader...!
I can't leave a thing like that alone!
That Lamaris has to be wiped out here!
Concentrating my attack on the Lamaris Ida...!
Ares Geist... I won't let you have your way!
I doubt it's actually a ghost, but...!
I didn't expect the Ares Geist to show up here...!
We can't let it be used...!
Carelessness can be fatal.../　Let me teach you that!
I won't let you go any further!
Looks like you failed to get away!
The enemy's still in my range...!
I won't let you get out of range!
Is this as far as I go...!?
N-Nothing... This is nothing/　compared to that accident!
Don't get carried away!/　I'm not finished yet!
This humiliation.../　My prosthetic left arm aches...!
This is not... where I die!
...! Any more of this,/　and even the R-2 won't...!
Ngh! I can't let the engine/　explode here...!
I'm hit!? But this machine/　won't go down that easily!
Checking damage.../　The thick armor paid off...!
Tch...! It's even harder/　to handle than the R-2!
I don't have time to waste on Reggiane...!
I have to shoot down the Floraga, fast...!
I need to get out of the Skull Knight's reach...!
So this is the deity ship's power...!
Not bad.../　but that's not enough to defeat me!
Interesting... You seem to have some skill.
Heh... So I still have much to learn.
That was careless.../　But I won't let you go any further.
Ugh! To take a direct hit...!
Damage check... I can still fight just fine.
Tch... It hit a bad spot...
So you targeted this unit./　I'll call that the right decision.
That won't be enough to bring down the R-2!
The power unit escaped a direct hit...!
Tch! It may be an easy target, but...
Holding its own against this Exbein... A skilled foe.
Jua-Mu, your raw ability is decent enough...!
I won't let you, Al-Van Ranks!
I won't let you go any further, Gu-Landon!
With a body that big, a direct hit won't be pretty...!
It seems to be updating its combat data.
You... Are you in a hurry to die?
How unlike me... Did I let my guard down?
This much... isn't even worth dodging.
I'll give you credit for hitting me.
Tch... Stay out of my way!
An attack like that/　can't pierce the R-2's armor.
You think that's enough to down the R-2?
Primary armor damaged.../　but no anomalies in the power unit.
Going by the book,/　targeting the low-mobility unit, I see.
I let Al-Van close the distance...!
You're not even worth talking to, Karo-Ran.
...So that's all an Emperor Unit amounts to.
Vort, you think that'll stop me in my tracks?!
I can't let this fight with the Floraga drag on...!
Are you just feeling us out, XN-L?
Ares Geist... Has its power dropped?
If we don't thin their numbers,/　we'll be at a disadvantage...!
To be latched onto by a monster...
Not good enough... Where are you aiming?!
Heh... Did you really think that would hit?
I make up for low mobility with skill.
With this unit.../　I can't afford to get hit so easily.
No need to even use the shield...
I know how to fight opponents like you.
Your petty taunts won't work on me, Karo-Ran.
Don't make me laugh,/　calling yourself an emperor with that.
No matter how good its performance,/　it's how you use it.
To use the Cross Gate like that...!
Are those wings just for show?
Skull Knight... Just pushing forward won't cut it.
I won't be destroyed by you, XN-L!
I've fought that unit many times.
I have no use for small fry!
Even Ryusei could dodge something like this.
Challenging me with that little.../　is reckless.
Next time, pick a target other than me.
Don't take it to heart./　You just picked the wrong opponent.
What's wrong?/　I can see you're getting desperate.
Heh... Can't even graze the R-GUN?
This unit isn't as sluggish as it looks.
With a body that huge,/　you can't aim with any precision?
What do you have those wings for?
Sorry.../　but that was a wasted effort.
I came prepared for this too.
From out of range.../　You know the basics of combat.
Where are you looking?/　This isn't over yet.
I'll take down as many as I can...!
Chalk it up to bad luck.
Clear the line of fire, Ryusei.
Well done, Ryusei. I'm following up.
Lieutenant Irm, I'll take it from here!
Well done, Lieutenant Irm... An opening!
Leona, leave the rest to me.
Don't forget to finish it, Leona.
Lieutenant Excellen,/　leave the rest to me.
Arieil, leave the rest to me.
Mai, leave the rest to me.
Behold the bond of our bloodline...
Honestly.../　He's just like Ryusei that way.
Rim, leave the rest to me.
Ing, I'll take it from here.
Lieutenant Calvina, I'll back you up!
Worship your big sister, Deadpan Boobs.
Mind if I spill all your secrets? Red Seaweed.
Mind if I tug on them from both sides?/　Those black panties.
Is that all this Bang-Bang Kaiser can do?
Ryusei, don't let your guard down!
Ryusei, don't focus only on attacking!
I won't let them get the Captain...!
Your Highness, I will protect you!
I won't give you time to scatter!
Tear my enemy apart! Beam Chakram!
Give it up... Hyzol Launcher, fire!!
Take this and turn to dust!
Burst Mode... I'll shoot them all down!
Focus on a single point... Target locked!
You two, we're going with R-Formation!
Will of destruction... become my blade!!
Ricochets... I just have to dodge them!
It's a tricky gun, but I'll manage!
B and E... I'll fire both at once!
Don't think you can escape the Jigan!
Not a single one gets away! Go!
Time to play my trump card!
At this range.../　It's risky, but the payoff's worth it!
Two baleful stars lead you to your death.
Let the baleful stars lure you/　to the realm of ruin.
Curse your misfortune in meeting me.
The fastest Missile there is./　You can't dodge it!
Take this strike from the heavens!
This is where it really begins!
The gravity sword... cannot be stopped.
The phoenix tolls the end of your fate.
Hm? Not a wolf and a cat?
Code DTD activated~ Leave it to me!
Lured by the ghost, vanish into darkness...
Isn't your shtick heading somewhere weird~?
The star of ill omen beckons you to hell...!
Can you stop arrows that fly in every direction?
You won't stop this continuous attack!
Every single shot drives you into a corner!
